changes.current_line: Billing that helps you grow revenue.
changes.change: For product and engineering leaders replacing a homegrown billing system: Change prices, trials and proration in a few clicks, so billing stops being a tax on your roadmap. Pair it with the live billing demo of a price change, which turns roadmap time into minutes.
changes.why: Owen rejected the revenue-growth framing outright, saying 'we're not trying to grow revenue with billing, we're trying to stop it being a tax on the roadmap', while the price-change demo landed as 'a quarter of roadmap in five minutes.'

changes.current_line: Proven ROI, backed by an independent economic impact study.
changes.change: For deals with no competitor other than the status quo, once the champion asks for material for finance: lead with the customer's own payback number, not the study. Use: We'll build your payback number with you this week, covering what your current billing system costs you in engineering time, billing errors and lapsed subscriptions, in a form your CFO can read. Keep the study as backup only.
changes.why: Owen asked 'do you have something that shows payback?' and said 'I can't get this past Diane without a number that's ours', and in a funding culture of 'if it isn't on fire, it isn't funded' the missing proof was their own cost figure.

changes.change: Add a cost-of-doing-nothing proof point for subscription businesses on homegrown billing: How many of your subscriptions lapse because a card fails and nobody chases it? Add it up. Link it to smart retries (M10) and include it as a line in the payback calculation.
changes.why: The rep learned that 'some landlord subscriptions lapse because the card fails and nobody chases it' but admitted 'We never added it up', leaving a concrete lost-revenue cost out of the business case.

changes.change: For buyers migrating off a homegrown billing system: offer a conversation with a reference customer who has already made the move, alongside the migration doc rather than instead of it.
changes.why: On migration the rep says 'We had a doc for that. He wanted to talk to someone who'd done it.', which shows a written doc did not satisfy the champion.
